source_english: Your safe return speaks volumes of your success.
translation_korean: 당신의 많은 성공들이 당신 자신의 안전을 증명합니다.

source_english: Please, don't continue speaking with me... time is of the essence.
translation_korean: 시간적 여유가 없으니 더 이상 저와 이야기하지 말아주셨으면 합니다.

source_english: Yes? What is it you want?
I don't belong. Not my place. Shouldn't have gone.
translation_korean: 나에게는 관계없는 것이야. 안에 들어와서는 안되었는데.

source_english: Very bad. I've been bad. I thought I was good, but I was bad. I've been punished. They'll all be punished.
translation_korean: 제 잘못이었어요. 전 잘못 없다고 생각했는데 제 잘못이었어요. 전 벌받을 거에요. 그들 모두 벌받을 거에요.

source_english: Ah! You must be the Arcane University's newest addition! This humble Battlemage bids you welcome!
translation_korean: 아! 아케인 대학에 새로 입학한 신입생이군요! 저는 보잘것없는 배틀메이지지만 당신을 환영합니다!

source_english: I can hardly believe you're standing here in front of me! The Listener himself! This is such an honor!
translation_korean: 당신께서 제 앞에 서 계시는 게 믿기지 않습니다! 청취자시라니! 크나큰 영광입니다!

source_english: I can hardly believe you're standing here in front of me! The Listener herself! This is such an honor!
translation_korean: 당신께서 제 앞에 서 계시는 게 믿기지 않습니다! 청취자시라니! 크나큰 영광입니다!

source_english: *Gasp!* Listener! How may I serve you?
I am yours to command, oh great Listener!
translation_korean: 저는 당신의 명령에 따릅니다, 오 위대한 청취자시여!

source_english: Your Highness? I am Narina Carvain, Countess of Bruma, at your service.
translation_korean: 전하, 전하의 신하, 브루마의 백작, 나리나 카베인(Narina Carvain) 백작입니다.

source_english: Can I ask you a favor?
Can I beg a favor of you?
Something seems... amiss with you, milady.
Something seems... amiss with you, milord.
You don't appear well, milady. Perhaps you should rest.
translation_korean: 좋아 보이지 않습니다, 주인님. 아마 쉬셔야 할 것 같군요.

source_english: You don't appear well, milord. Perhaps you should rest.
translation_korean: 좋아 보이지 않습니다, 주인님. 아마 쉬셔야 할 것 같군요.

source_english: Can't wait to get out of here.
I can't wait... finally I'm away from that horrid store.
translation_korean: 기다릴 수 없었어... 결국, 저 무서운 가게에서 나와 버렸어.
최근 당신이 예전처럼 안 보이는 군요.

source_english: You should really get to a healer. You're looking rather pale.
Have you been well recently? Your skin looks a bit... off.
translation_korean: 요새 잘 지내고 있나요? 당신의 피부가 안 좋아 보여요.

source_english: Is everything all right? You look a bit ill.
Is everything all right? You look a bit ill.
How could the Nine let this happen? Are they angry with us?
translation_korean: 어째서 나인 디바인(Nine)은 보고만 있는거지? 우리가 뭘 잘못했지?

source_english: I've looked everywhere. Perhaps she's still in Kvatch, in a basement, hiding?
translation_korean: 모두 찾아봤어. 그녀는 아직 크바치(Kvatch)에 있는 것 같아. 지하실에라도 숨었을까?

source_english: I'm just tired. I can't face it. I have to start over, from nothing.
translation_korean: 난 완전히 지쳤어. 싸울 힘도 없고, 아무것도 할 수가 없어.

source_english: Kvatch is finished. There's nothing left.
You must be the Gray Fox. Your reputation precedes you, as I'm sure you know.
translation_korean: 당신은 그레이 폭스이어야만 합니다. 당신도 알고 있겠지만, 당신의 평판은 당신보다 앞서 갑니다.

source_english: You're the Gray Fox! Please don't hurt me!
translation_korean: 당신은 그레이 폭스(Gray Fox)요! 제발 해치지 마시오!

source_english: It's the Gray Fox! I can't believe it's really you!
translation_korean: 그레이 폭스야! 난 정말 당신을 믿을 수 없어!

source_english: You're the Gray Fox! Thank you for everything you've done to help us here in the waterfront.
translation_korean: 당신은 그레이 폭스(Gray Fox)요! 워트프론트 여기에서 우리를 도와주신 모든것에 감사 드립니다.

source_english: Many thanks. I'm preparing the ship for her return.
translation_korean: 많이 감사합니다. 귀환을 위해 준비하고 있습니다.

source_english: I'm here for my book. Mankar Camoran's "Commentaries," Volume Three.
translation_korean: 내 책, 맨카 케모런(Mankar Camoran)의 "논평집" 3권을 가지러 왔소.

source_english: You choose to share your time with me? You humble me.
I am at your service, Arch-Mage.
What can I do for you, Arch-Mage?
The Moth Priests seem agitated today.
translation_korean: 나방 사제들이 오늘 흥분한 것 같은데.

source_english: I pulled duty outside the Imperial Libray tonight. Curse my luck. Being that close to the Elder Scrolls gives me the creeps.
translation_korean: 엘더스크롤 가까이 있다는 게 약간 소름 끼쳐. 난 오늘 밤 제국 도서관에서 근무를 해야 한다구. 저주받을 내 운 같으니.

source_english: I don't see how the Empire can survive without an emperor.
translation_korean: 황제 없이 제국이 어떻게 살아남을지 궁금하군.

source_english: Barkeep! A drink for my friend!
translation_korean: 주인장! 내 친구에게 술 한잔 주시오!

source_english: Have you heard? Someone's been murdered! One of us!
translation_korean: 얘기 들었어? 사람이 살해 당했어요! 우리 중 하나가!

source_english: What kind of party is this? Someone has been murdered!
Is that why someone invited us here? To kill us? This is horrible!
translation_korean: 그것이 누군가가 우리를 여기로 초대한 이유입니까? 우리를 죽이려고? 정말 끔찍한 일이군요!

source_english: Are you all right? This murder has us all on edge, I know.
translation_korean: 너 괜찮니? 내가 보기에 이 살인은 우리 모두를 안절부절못하게 하는군요.

source_english: I know someone's been murdered and we're all on edge. Just try to remain calm. I'll get to the bottom of this.
translation_korean: 누군가가 살해당했고 다들 동요하고 있단 거 압니다. 일단 침착하려고 해 보세요. 제가 조사해 보겠습니다.

source_english: So, here we all are. It certainly is a nice house.
translation_korean: 그러면, 여기 우리 모두가 있습니다. 확실히 좋은 집입니다.

source_english: This citizen is accusing you of stealing the bust of Llathasa from Cheydinhal. I even found the bust in your cabinet. What do you have to say?
translation_korean: 이 시민이 Cheydinhal에서 Llathasa의 입상을 훔친 당신을 고발합니다. 나는 이미 당신의 장식장에서 입상을 발견했습니다. 더 이상 무슨 말이 필요합니까?

source_english: You are a skillful thief. The guild is lucky to have you.
translation_korean: 당신은 실력 있는 도둑이죠. 당신이 있는 건 길드에 행운이에요.

source_english: The Gray Fox appreciates all you've done for the guild.
translation_korean: 그레이 폭스는 당신이 길드를 위해 해준 모든 것에 대해 감사 드립니다.

source_english: I see you're a follower of the Gray Fox, too.
translation_korean: 난 당신이 그레이 폭스의 후계자라고 봐요.

source_english: That good-for-nothing husband's going to be very surprised if he crawls back here. Very surprised.
translation_korean: 만일 보잘 것 없는 남편이 굽실거리며 돌아온다면 놀랄 거에요. 매우 놀랄 거에요.

source_english: Ohhhh... what am I to do? They're gone... all gone.
translation_korean: 아아아아... 어떻게 하면 좋을까? 사라져 버렸어... 전부.

source_english: Well met. I trust no great harm has befallen you.
translation_korean: 반갑습니다. 큰 위험이 당신에게 닥치지 않았기를 믿습니다.

source_english: If you're here to rob me, I'm afraid I have nothing left.
I could use some good news right about now.
translation_korean: 바로 지금쯤이면 뭔가 좋은 소식이 있어야 할 텐데요.

source_english: Thank goodness someone that can help is here!
translation_korean: 도와줄 수 있는 사람이 여기 있어서 감사할 뿐이에요!

source_english: I feel much better now that you're here.
translation_korean: 당신이 여기 계셔서 굉장히 안심이 됩니다.

source_english: So, what brings you here today?
Yes, Guildmaster? What can I do for you?
Heard they made you master. Gods help us all.
translation_korean: 그들이 너를 마스터 시킨걸 들었다. 신들이 우리를 도와줄거다.

source_english: What's on your mind, Guildmaster? Need me to kill something?
translation_korean: 너의 생각은 어떻냐?, 길드마스터? 무언가 죽이기 위해 나를 필요로 하는거냐?

source_english: Master... I'll never get used to saying that. What can I do for you?
translation_korean: 마스터(Mater)...나는 결코 그런이야기를 하는데 익숙하지 않다. 무엇을 원하나?

source_english: Is that a bit of frostbite I see? Hehehe.
translation_korean: 내가 보고 있는 게 그 얼음조각이라고요? 헤헤헤.

source_english: Welcome back to the University. It's good to see you again.
translation_korean: 대학에 돌아온 걸 환영해요. 당신을 다시 보게 돼서 기쁘군요.

source_english: How nice to see you again.
I see you haven't yet been able to drop the staff in Darkfathom Cave.
translation_korean: 아직 당신이 어두운 측연 동굴에 가서 그 지팡이를 두고 오지 않았단 걸 알아요.

source_english: Please, do what you can to protect Antus. He's just a kid.
translation_korean: 부탁입니다, 안투스를 지켜주세요. 그 앤 정말 어립니다.

source_english: What can I do for you, stranger?
Don't falter! We have them! We have them!
translation_korean: 머뭇거리지마! 우리가 잡는다! 우리가 잡는다고! As if in battle

source_english: You can do it, Antus. You can do it... just follow big brother's lead...
translation_korean: 넌 할 수 있어, Antus. 넌 할 수 있다고... 단지 큰 형의 지시만 따르면 되는 거야...

source_english: You again. Are you ready yet?
You're back! You must tell me everything!
Please, don't waste time speaking to an old man. Go and help my sons.
translation_korean: 제발, 늙은이와 얘기하느라 시간을 낭비하지 말아주게. 가서 내 아들들을 도와줘.

source_english: Hello. You haven't seen my sons, have you? They went off into the forest to fight those monsters, and I'm worried about them.
translation_korean: 안녕하신가? 자넨 내 아들들을 본 적이 없겠군, 그렇지? 그 애들은 괴물들과 싸우기 위해 숲으로 갔어. 난 그 애들이 걱정된다네.

source_english: Thanks to you, Cheydinhal is safe.
It's good to set my foot upon the soil of my home.
translation_korean: 고향 땅을 밟아보는 기분이 정말 좋군.

source_english: What a horrible turn of events.
Strange... with all the lava, you'd think I'd be warm, but all I feel is a bone-chilling cold. Perhaps it's fear...
translation_korean: 이상하군... 용암 때문에 더울 것 같은데, 뼛속까지 시린 한기가 느껴집니다. 공포 때문이겠죠...

source_english: If it wasn't for you, I never would have found Reynald. Thank you.
translation_korean: 당신이 아니었다면, 전 결코 레이날드를 찾지 못했을 겁니다. 고맙습니다.

source_english: I can't believe I've been reunited with my brother!
How can I help you today, friend?
You don't look well, my friend. You should seek a healer.
translation_korean: 몸상태가 좋지 않은 것 같군요. 치료를 받아 보는게 좋겠어요.

source_english: Have you been to a Healer recently? Because you don't look so good.
translation_korean: 최근에 치료는 받았습니까? 상태가 그리 좋아 보이진 않군요.

source_english: Meet you at The Count's Arms. Good luck.
translation_korean: 백작의 권력 여관에서 만나죠. 행운을 빕니다.

source_english: Just hold the ghosts off while I figure out how to open this damn door.
translation_korean: 내가 이 빌어먹을 문을 어떻게 열지 생각하는 동안 당신은 유령이나 떨어뜨려 주세요.
알레론 에 대한 어떤 말이라도 있나요?

source_english: At last we meet in the flesh.
I've got your horse saddled and waiting for you.
translation_korean: 말에 안장을 얹고 당신을 기다리고 있었습니다.

source_english: He's been fed and well rested for you.
translation_korean: 당신을 위해 그 놈은 잘 먹이고 잘 쉬었습니다.

source_english: You have purchased a fine piece of horseflesh.
I have your horse right here.
All citizens are welcome in the Imperial Palace, at least on the first two floors.
translation_korean: 임페리얼 궁전은 적어도 일층과 이층에 한해서 만큼은 모든 시민들에게 개방되어 있소.

source_english: Remember, trespassing in the Imperial Palace is a serious crime. Do not venture beyond the first and second floors.
translation_korean: 기억하십시오, 제국 황궁에 무단 침입하는 것은 심각한 범죄입니다. 1층과 2층 외에는 출입이 금지되어 있습니다.

source_english: It looks thievy to this one.
You must be the new slop drudge.
Changed your mind, have you? The offer's still good.
translation_korean: 생각을 좀 바꿔 보시죠? 저희는 항상 좋은것만 제공합니다.

source_english: I can't believe it's over... that giant demon... the Dragon... what happened? Have we won?
translation_korean: 끝났다는 게 믿기지가 않아... 그 거대한 악마... 드래곤... 무슨 일이 일어난 거지? 우리가 이긴 건가?

source_english: Did you see it? The avatar of Akatosh himself? There it is! The monument to our deliverance!
translation_korean: 보여? 아카토쉬(Akatosh)의 화신 맞지? 바로 그거야! 해방의 상징이라구!

source_english: We're alive! You did it! You beat that monster! We won!
translation_korean: 우린 살았어! 당신이 해냈어! 괴물을 물리쳤다구! 우리가 이겼어!

source_english: I've put myself in your hands.
All hail the Champion of Cyrodiil!
How can I assist you, Champion?
It's... It's you! The Hero of Kvatch! This is truly an honor!
translation_korean: 당신... 당신이군요! 크바치의 영웅! 이거 정말 영광입니다!

source_english: Hail, good citizen! How can I be of service?
I wish I could have helped you deal with the rest of those Mythic Dawn bastards. But it seems you did all right on your own.
translation_korean: 자네와 함께 빌어먹을 미식 던(Mythic Dawn) 놈들을 처치하고 싶지만, 알아서 잘 처리하리라 믿네.

source_english: Good work tracking down the Mythic Dawn's secret shrine. We finally took the fight to the enemy.
translation_korean: 미식 던(Mythic Dawn)의 비밀 성지를 캐낸 건 잘 했네. 우린 결국은 적과 맞서게 될걸세.

source_english: I'll feel better when you've eliminated those spies. There's no telling what they may be planning.
translation_korean: 스파이가 제거되어야 안심할 것 같네. 그래야 놈들의 계획이 무산될 테니 말일세.

source_english: Have you spoken to Martin yet? The plans you found make it clear that time is short.
translation_korean: 마틴께 상의해 보았나? 놈들의 계획대로라면 시간이 없어.

source_english: I've made some progress with the Mysterium Xarxes, finally!
translation_korean: 자서스(Xarxes) 신비에 대해 약간의 진전이 있었네!

source_english: The Mysterium Xarxes is the most dangerous daedric sorcery I've ever encountered.
translation_korean: 자서스(Xarxes) 신비는 내가 접해본 것 중 가장 위험한 데이드릭 마법이네.

source_english: I can't escape the Xarxes, even in my dreams. I wonder if my warding spells will be enough.
translation_korean: 꿈에서 조차도 자서스(Xarxes)에 시달리고 있네. 내 보호 주문이 통할지 걱정이네.

source_english: I'll have to proceed cautiously with the Mysterium Xarxes. It is exceedingly dangerous.
translation_korean: 아주 조심스럽게 자서스(Xarxes) 신비에 다가가야 해. 이건 정말 위험한 일이네.

source_english: I have good news! I've made some progress on deciphering the gate-opening ritual.
translation_korean: 좋은 소식이네! 문을 열 의식을 해독하는데 다소 진전이 있었네.

source_english: I'm glad to see you. I'm finally starting to unlock the secrets of the second half of the gate-opening ritual.
translation_korean: 만나서 반갑군요. 관문을 여는 의식의 두 번째 부분을 해독하려던 참이었습니다.

source_english: I don't suppose you've found those fugitives yet.
translation_korean: 자네 아직 그 탈주범들을 찾지 못한 것으로 보이는군.

source_english: Shouldn't you be in Bravil? Being useful?
translation_korean: 자네 브라빌에 있지 않았나? 쓸모 있어지기 위해서 말이야?

source_english: We is most pleased... eth... ified.
Oh. Yes. How do you do?
You should be helping out Elante by now.
You and Maglir need to catch those thieves.
translation_korean: 당신과 Maglir 는 이 도둑들을 처리해야하오.

source_english: Shouldn't you be helping Norbert Lelles?
translation_korean: 당신은  Norbert Lelles를 돕고있어야 하지 않나요?

source_english: What did you do to my little rats?
translation_korean: 내 귀여운 쥐들에게 무슨 짓을 했죠?

source_english: Can't you see that I'm very busy?!
I need a moment of your time. It's urgent.
translation_korean: 잠시 시간 좀 내줘. 긴급 사항이야.

source_english: Ah, there you are. We need to talk.
translation_korean: 아, 여기 있었군. 얘기 좀 하세.

source_english: Do you have a moment? There's something we need to discuss.
I need to talk to you, soldier to soldier.
translation_korean: 군인 대 군인으로 할 얘기가 있네.

source_english: Something's come up. It can't wait.
I'm close to understanding the complete gate-opening ritual. The final section is almost within my grasp.
translation_korean: 의식에 필요한 것들을 모두 알 것 같군. 이젠 마지막 부분도 거의 이해될 것 같네.

source_english: Hmmm. Another comes to us. What is it?
You finish the clean-up, new blood. Look in the houses. Get moving, so we can go home.
translation_korean: 새로운 피가 깔끔하게 마무리할거다. 집을 조사해라. 집에 가기위해 움직여라.

source_english: Do I want to hear this?
Silencer! You have returned! What news of the traitor?
translation_korean: 사이랜서! 당신이 돌아왔군! 무슨 배신자의 소식이라도?
네, Master, 당신은 나를 필요로 합니까?

source_english: Get yer Black Horse Courier here!
Everybody needs a copy of the Black Horse Courier!
Don't be the last to read today's Black Horse Courier!
translation_korean: 오늘의 블랙 호스 신문입니다. 늦지 않게 서두르세요!

source_english: Looking for other jobs? Don't look at me.
Well I'll be a spotted Snow Bear -- a customer!
translation_korean: 잘 오세요, 난 언제나 여기 있습니다 -- 손님!

source_english: Pardon me, noble Scholar, but... Could I speak with you a minute?
translation_korean: 실례해요, 존경하는 학자님, 그런데 잠시만 얘기할 수 있을까요?

source_english: Mind telling me why you're sneakin' about? I don't think I have to tell you what the Legion thinks of thieves, now do I?
translation_korean: 네 놈이 몰래 기어들어온 이유를 내 마음이 말해주더군. 제국군이 도둑을 어떻게 생각하는지에 대해서 말할 필요가 없다고 생각하는데, 듣고 싶나?

source_english: Whoa, girl! Whoa! Easy now... It's all right. Sorry, civilian. My steed gets spooked a bit easily. It's all those damn goblins and trolls, you see.
translation_korean: 워,워! 진정해... 됐어요, 죄송합니다. 제 말은 좀 쉽게 겁에 질리거든요. 이게 당신도 봤을 그 망할 고블린과 트롤들 때문입니다.

source_english: Apprentice! Wait right there. We need to talk.
translation_korean: 견습생이여! 거기에 잠시만요. 말 좀 합시다.

source_english: Fellow magister, may I speak with you?
translation_korean: 동료 마법사 님, 잠시 시간좀 내 주시겠어요?

source_english: I know you're busy, but I need a moment of your time.
Magister! We must talk! Please... It's rather urgent.
translation_korean: 마법사 님! 할 이야기가 있어요! 제발요... 꽤 급한 일이에요.

source_english: Excuse me, fellow magister. Is now a good time to talk?
translation_korean: 실례합니다, 동료 마법사 님. 잠시 시간 좀 뺐어도 되겠습니까?

source_english: Ahh, magister. I just remembered, there's something I'd like to discuss with you.
translation_korean: 아아, 마법사 님. 방금 기억났는데, 당신과 잠시 토의할 게 있어요.

source_english: Baurus. I want you to know... I don't blame you for what happened. You did everything you could. I'm glad to have you here by my side.
translation_korean: 보러스(Baurus), 알아 주게... 어떤 일이 있었던지 난 원망하지 않네. 자네는 최선을 다했어. 자네가 여기 내 곁에 있는 것이 기쁘네.

source_english: Bladesman, I was wondering if I might have a word?
translation_korean: 블레이드 여러분, 할말을 좀 해도 될까요?

source_english: Excuse me. If you have a moment, I would speak with you.
Hail Blade. Do you have a moment to talk?
translation_korean: 여, 병사. 잠시 얘기 좀 할까?

source_english: Caroline. Don't let me keep you.

translation_korean: 롤리안드(Roliand), 잘 될 거야, 날 믿게.
이 보게, 병사. 무슨 일 있나?

source_english: My lord... I would speak with you.
My lord, I was wondering if I could speak with you. I understand that you have many more pressing concerns...
translation_korean: 주군, 중요한 일이 많으신 줄 알고 있습니다만... 잠시 말씀 드려도 괜찮겠습니까?

source_english: My lord, please excuse my presumption, but I would speak with you.
translation_korean: 주군, 무례를 용서하시길... 드릴 말씀이 있습니다.

source_english: Good day to you, my lord.
The fishing is best when it's raining like this. The fish all come right to the top. It's like they're waiting to be caught.
translation_korean: 낚시는 이처럼 비 올 때가 가장 좋은 법이지. 물고기들이 모두 위로 모이거든. 마치 잡히길 기다리는 것처럼 말일세.

source_english: Finally, I'll be able to retire.
Still staying away from my fishing spots? I may be retired but they're still mine, you understand?
translation_korean: 아직도 내 낚시터에서 얼쩡대나? 내가 은퇴했을지 언정 여전히 거긴 내 소유라네, 알겠나?

source_english: Yessir, no more fish for me. Just long peaceful days ahead for ol' Aelwin Merowald.
translation_korean: 내게는 더 필요가 없네. 늙은 Aelwin Merowald에겐 긴 평화로운 날들이 있을 뿐이야.

source_english: To what do I owe this pleasure?
Should you need something, I will be happy to oblige.
translation_korean: 뭔가 필요하다면, 내 기꺼이 들어 드리리다.

source_english: Welcome. Please, don't be shy. I'm listening.
translation_korean: 어서오세요. 아무쪼록 주저하지 마시고 얘기해 보세요.

source_english: How does the day greet you, friend?
I suppose I have a moment. What is it?
I am busy, so, if you will excuse me.
I hope this won't take long.
Is it necessary that you speak with me?
Be quick about this or find someone else to talk to.
translation_korean: 이야기 하려면 서둘러 주겠나. 아니면 다른 사람을 찾아보던가.

source_english: You hardly seem worth talking to.
I'm very happy to make your acquaintance.
I am never too busy for good talk.
It's so good to meet you.
Spit it out or hit the road.
Whatever you're looking for, I'm sure I don't know how to find it.
translation_korean: 뭘 찾는진 몰라도, 난 모른다는 것만은 분명합니다.

source_english: If you'll excuse me, I don't have time for you right now. Or ever.
translation_korean: 실례지만, 지금 좀 시간이 없어요. 그럼.

source_english: What hole did you crawl out of?
You remind me of my homeland. During the Blight.
translation_korean: 당신을 보니 제 고향이 떠오르는군요. 황폐한 시기의.

source_english: Welcome! If you wish to talk, it is really no trouble at all.
translation_korean: 환영합니다. 대화하길 원하신다면, 전혀 문제될거 없습니다.

source_english: You're in good company, friend. Welcome.
You seem quite intriguing. Please, share your thoughts.
translation_korean: 흥미로워 보이네요. 어디, 의견을 나눠 봅시다.

source_english: Greetings. What exactly do you require of me?
Ah, how quaint. How do you do?
Is it necessary that you speak with ME?
You creatures are all the same.
May you walk on warm sands.
Good friend. This is an honor.
Speak while the sands are warm.
Khajiit has no words for you.
It comes near. What does it want?
To greet you? Or eat you?
Go away. Do not come back.
Can it speak? Can it make words?
Well, here's a fine one! Speak freely.
Salute! Welcome! Please say your piece.
This is a grand day. Greetings.
Today's your lucky day, so let's hear it.
translation_korean: 오늘은 재수가 좋네요, 어디 한번 들어보죠.

source_english: I take it you want something. Well, what is it?
translation_korean: 당신은 뭔가 원하고 있나본데, 그래, 그게 뭔가?

source_english: May the wind be on your back.
Say your piece or stand aside.
Someone should teach you some manners.
Bother me again, and you might live to regret it.
You remind me of a witch I once knew. I hate witches.
translation_korean: 너를 보고 있으면 마녀(witches)가 생각이 난다. 나는 마녀가 싫다.

source_english: Get out of here before you get hurt.
Are you here to challenge me? I don't think so.
I feel I can truly share with you, without fear.
translation_korean: 나는 아무 문제없이 당신과 해 나갈 것이오.

source_english: A sincere welcome to you. May you be forever blessed.
A hail and hardy welcome, friend.
Do not fear. I will assist you however I can.
May your kills be quick and many.
Blade and bone. Speak to me.
Hurry up, before I change my mind.
By what right do you disturb me?
translation_korean: 무슨 권리로, 날 이렇게 불쾌하게 하는거지?

source_english: I've killed far worse than you.
What did I do to deserve this honor?
You've got my ear. Let's hear it.
translation_korean: 당신 내 귀를 사로 잡는군. 한번 들어 보자구.

source_english: Talk is free. What do you want?
translation_korean: 말하는 거야 자유지. 뭘 원하는 거야?

source_english: Nothing's keeping you here. So move on.
translation_korean: 여기 있을 필요 없어. 자 움직이자.

source_english: If you're looking for trouble, you're getting very warm.
translation_korean: 문제거리를 찾고있는 거라면, 지금이 바로 그래.

source_english: If there is anything I can do, I am humbly at your service.
translation_korean: 뭔가 할 수 있는 일이 있으면, 사양말고 말해 주세요.

source_english: I have a feeling that you and I are about to become very close.
This is a wondrous encounter. Welcome.
I'm so happy to see you, I could burst!
I don't know if I can help you, but I'll try.
translation_korean: 도움이 될 수 있을지 모르겠지만, 도와줄게요.

source_english: Do you want something from me?
Can't you find someone else to bother?
Can't you see I wish to be left alone!
translation_korean: 내가 혼자 있고 싶어 하는게 안보이나!

source_english: I really don't want you around me.
Please show your respect for the Imperial Palace by keeping your voice down.
translation_korean: 제국 황궁에서는 목소리를 낮추는 예의를 갖추십시오.

source_english: All visitors to the Imperial Palace are asked to keep their voices down, especially if the Council is in session.
translation_korean: 모든 임페리얼 궁전 방문자들은 특히, 위원회가 회의 중일 때는 목소리를 낮춰야 하오.

source_english: Take your flies and your sores over there.
translation_korean: 네 파리들과 상처를 저기로 가져 가라고.

source_english: Get a cure! And keep your distance.
Gods! Pox and rot! Get away from me!
translation_korean: 젠장 할! 천연두와 부패병! 내게서 떨어져!

source_english: Shoo! Flies, lice and disease? No, thank you.
translation_korean: 쉿! 파리와 이에다 질병이라고? 아니, 사양할게.

source_english: All's quiet, eh? Times like this I think the thieves are all away on holiday.
translation_korean: 모든 게 조용하군, 그렇지? 이럴 때 난 도둑들이 모두 휴가를 떠났다는 생각이 들더라구.

source_english: Hail, fellow horseman! All's quiet in your stretch of the wild, I hope.
translation_korean: 반갑네, 친구. 자네 구역이 조용하길 바라네.

source_english: So? What do you have to report?
You look tired, my friend. I hope you're holding up all right.
What do you say, pal? Seen any action?
translation_korean: 뭐라고 말하는 건가, 친구? 뭐라도 봤어?

source_english: How goes it, friend? Keeping the killers and cutpurses at bay?
translation_korean: 어떻게 지내나, 친구? 살인자와 소매치기들이 아직 만에 있나?

source_english: I'm just lucky to be alive.
I just can't sleep. I lie down and close my eyes, but I can't stop thinking about it.
translation_korean: 잠을 이룰 수가 없어. 누워서 눈을 감아도 그 생각 때문에 잘 수가 없어.

source_english: It's the smell, really. Smoke and fire. And something worse. In the ruins.
translation_korean: 온통 화염과 연기 냄세 뿐이군. 폐허도 이보단 덜 할거야.

source_english: Waiting's been difficult, I hope your journey was successful.
translation_korean: 기다리는 게 힘들더군. 자네 여행이 성공적이었기 바라네.

source_english: Ten years of research down the drain...
I'm so happy to see you again!
Sorry, I have little time to speak.
You are always welcome at Harm's Folly.
Now that I have my notes back, my research continues.
translation_korean: 이제 내 노트가 돌아왔기에, 연구는 계속됩니다.

source_english: Ah, my savior. Back again for a visit are we?
translation_korean: 아, 나의 구원자여. 우리를 방문하기 위해서 돌아와 주신 건가요?

source_english: So, what's the news from Greyland?
Well met, adventurer. A moment of your time if you please.
translation_korean: 만나서 반갑네, 모험가, 괜찮으면 시간좀 내줄수 있겠나?

source_english: Whew. I've never worked so hard on a formula in my life, but I got your Grand Elixir of Exploration done.
translation_korean: 휴. 내 인생에서 이토록 열심히 일한 적이 없었어요. 그래도 당신의 고급 영약이 완성됐습니다.

source_english: Researching the Elixir has been exhausting, but well worth the time.
translation_korean: 엘릭서 연구는 힘이 드는 일이지만, 충분히 그만한 가치가 있지요.

source_english: Your Strong Elixir is complete. I think you'll be pleased with the results.
translation_korean: 강력 영약이 완료되었습니다. 결과에 만족하실 거라 봅니다.

source_english: The process of alchemy is much easier when the alchemist isn't being bothered.
translation_korean: 연금술사가 방해받지 않아야 연금술의 공정이 더 편해지겠지요.

source_english: Please tell me you have more Nirnroot for me.
translation_korean: 더 많은 넌루트를 가지고 와준건가? 제발 그렇다고 해주게.

source_english: One Moderate Elixir of Exploration, coming right up!
Need I remind you once more?
Don't leave before you hear what I have to tell you. You'll regret it.
translation_korean: 해줄 말이 있으니 듣기전에 떠나지 마세요. 그렇지 않으면 후회할게 분명합니다.

source_english: What brings you to my little home underground?
translation_korean: 무슨 일로 내 작은 집 지하에 오셨나요?

source_english: Welcome to my home underground. Hehe.
translation_korean: 우리 집 지하에 오신 것을 환영합니다. 헤헤.

source_english: I hope you've made the necessary preparations.
These scamps are making my home smell like a barn.
translation_korean: 이놈의 스캠프들이 제 집을 냄새나는 헛간처럼 만들고 있어요.

source_english: Damn it, now they're into my pantry!
translation_korean: 빌어먹을, 지금 그 놈들이 내 식료품실에 있다고요!

source_english: Whatever you do... don't leave me alone with these things!
translation_korean: 당신이 뭘 하던 간에... 이것들과 나만 남겨두고 가지 마세요!

source_english: The staff and the scamps are gone! You must have made it to Darkfathom Cave.
translation_korean: 그 지팡이와 스캠프들이 사라지다니! 당신이 어두운 측연 동굴에 그걸 두고 온 게 틀림없군요!

source_english: You've returned. And with the little ones in tow. Lovely.
translation_korean: 돌아왔군요. 더불어 그 작은 것들과 함께 말이죠. 잘났군요.

source_english: Are you here to help Rosentia?
I am anxious to hear news of the book.
I'm a busy man. What is it?
By the gods, what do you want?
I was praying for your swift return.
translation_korean: 당신의 빠른 귀환을 위해 기도하고 있었어요.

source_english: Can't you see that I'm busy?
I don't know you, and I don't care to know you.
translation_korean: 난 널 알지도 못할 뿐더러 알고 싶지도 않아.

source_english: All that work gone to waste.
How nice to see you again.
Got a lot to do here. We can talk later in Anvil.
translation_korean: 여기선 할 일이 많네. 나중에 엔빌에서 얘기할수 있을걸세.

source_english: Such a pleasure to be in good company.
translation_korean: 좋은 사람과 알게 되어서 참 좋군요.

source_english: Oh, the big tough slayer has returned... tremble in fear! Ahahaha!
translation_korean: 오, 거칠고 용맹한 살해자가 돌아왔다... 공포로 떨어라! 하하하하!

source_english: Something the matter with your eyes? There will be if you keep gawkin' at me like that.
translation_korean: 당신 눈이 뭔가 문제 있습니까? 그렇게 나를 얼빠진듯이 쳐다보면은 후환이 있을 겁니다.

source_english: Come to gloat, eh? Well, you'll get no apologies from me.
translation_korean: 우쭐대러 왔냐, 어? 흥, 내가 사과라도 할 줄 알았냐.

source_english: It's wonderful to see you again.
A hearty hello to you. So good to see you again!
translation_korean: 진심으로 환영합니다. 다시 만나게 되어 좋군요!

source_english: Fellow Knight! I bid you welcome.
I'm honored by your presence, friend.
It's good to see you, serjo.
Please leave me alone. I have important things to do.
translation_korean: 제발 날 내버려 주십시오. 해야 할 중요한 것들이 있습니다.

source_english: You grace my presence once again.
translation_korean: 당신을 다시 뵙게 되어 정말 기쁩니다.

source_english: I'm pleased to see you again.
translation_korean: 당신을 다시 뵙게 돼서 정말 기쁩니다.

source_english: Important things to do... so many important things to do.
translation_korean: 해야 할 중요한 일... 해야 할 더욱 중요한 일들.

source_english: I've more important things to do than chat with you right now.
translation_korean: 나는 지금 당신과 얘기하는 것보다 해야 할 더 중요한 것이 있습니다.

source_english: Sorry, I'm too busy to speak to you now.
translation_korean: 미안, 지금 당신에게 얘기하기에는 너무 바빠요.

source_english: It is a privilege to see you again.
So good of you to drop by again.
I'm feeling much better now that the house is free of those ugly creatures.
translation_korean: 그 추한 생물이 이 집에 없어지니 기분이 훨씬 좋습니다.

source_english: Rosentia sent word ahead that she has you to thank for freeing her of those accursed little beasts.
translation_korean: 그 저주받을 작은 짐승놈들로부터 해방시켜 주셔서 로젠티아가 감사의 인사를 보내 왔습니다.

source_english: It's good to see you again.
It's nice to see you again.
I sing your praises and welcome you again.

translation_korean: 당신이 본색을 드러낼 줄 알고 있었죠.

source_english: Don't keep us waiting. I hate to wait.
translation_korean: 기다리게 하지 마세요. 기다리는 건 질색이니까.

source_english: Hmmm. You may be just what we've been looking for.
translation_korean: 흠. 당신은 우리가 찾고 있는 사람에 딱 맞는 인물이군요.

source_english: Yes, you'll do just fine. Signy will tell you all the details.
translation_korean: 그래요, 당신은 정말 멋진 일을 하게 될 거에요. 시그니가 자세히 말해줄 겁니다.

source_english: Well now, who do we have here?
What are you waiting for? Kill me!
Ah, I sense a gambling man!
Ah, I sense a woman of chance!
translation_korean: 아, 운 좋은 여인이 느껴지는 군!

source_english: By Azura, by Azura, by Azura! It's the Grand Champion! I can't believe it's you! Standing here! Next to me!
translation_korean: 아주라, 아주라, 아주라시여! 그랜드 챔피언이라니! 당신이 여기 제 옆에! 서 있다니 믿기지가 않습니다!

source_english: We should get out of here.
This doesn't look good. Not good at all.
You're always welcome in Border Watch!
Time is wasting. We must move swiftly!
If only we had our home back...
Ahhh. So good to be back home.
You have but to lead us to Weatherleah.
Is your weapon stained with the foul blood of the ogres?
translation_korean: 오우거들의 더러운 피로 당신의 무기가 더럽혀진 건 아닌가요?

source_english: Nothing is as important as a man's home. We must have ours back.
translation_korean: 사람에게 집만큼 중요한 것은 또 없습니다. 저희는 꼭 집을 되찾을 겁니다.

source_english: Perchance, dare I ask another favor?
You're back. I trust everything went as planned?
translation_korean: 돌아왔군. 모든 게 계획대로 됐다고 믿어도 되겠나?

source_english: Excuse me, may I have a moment of your time?
translation_korean: 잠시 실례, 시간을 좀 내 줄 수 있겠나?

source_english: What's going on here? Who's this?
translation_korean: 여기서 뭐하고 있지? 이 놈은 누군가?

source_english: Please, don't let Anaxes loose! He torments us night and day!
translation_korean: 제발, 아나제스(Anaxes)를 풀어주지 마시오! 그는 우릴 밤낮으로 괴롭힌다오!

source_english: Just leave us alone. We have enough troubles here in the Savage Garden without you adding to them.
translation_korean: 우릴 그냥 내버려 두시오. 당신이 보태지 않아도 야생의 정원에서 충분히 괴롭소.

source_english: You're not one of us, are you? Are you here to destroy Gaiar Alata and end our nightmare?
translation_korean: 우리들 중 하나가 아니군요, 그렇죠? 가이아 알라타(Gaiar Alata)를 파괴하고 우리의 악몽을 끝내러 오셨나요?

source_english: I will soon earn the Master's favor and be granted entry into the Forbidden Grotto.
translation_korean: 나는 곧 마스터의 신임을 얻어서 금단의 동굴로 들어가는 것이 용인 될 것이오.

source_english: What news from Tamriel? Is Lord Dagon's victory almost complete?
translation_korean: 탐리엘의 새로운 소식 없소? 데이건 군주의 승리가 거의 마무리됐다던지 하는 그런 소식 말이오?

source_english: How can you be here? The Master said you were dead!
translation_korean: 어떻게 여기 있소? 마스터께서 당신이 죽었다던데!

source_english: You're new to Gaiar Alata, aren't you?
Please, end this nightmare if you can.
translation_korean: 할 수 있으면, 부디 악몽을 끝내 주시오.

source_english: Hmmm... you look familiar. If only I could remember.
translation_korean: 흐음... 당신 낯이 익군요. 내가 기억할 수 있다면 좋겠는데.

source_english: Unless there's a drink in this for me, you might as well stop talking.
translation_korean: 날 위해 이걸 마시지 않으면, 말 하는 것 또한 멈출 지 몰라요.
그는 모두를 보고 있고, 알고 있지.

source_english: All honor to the Hide and the Wearer.
All honor to the Ebony Blade.
We honor the Rose and its bearer.
A merry dance for the Lord of Chance.
translation_korean: Lord of Chance을 위해 신나는 댄스를.

source_english: What more can I do for you?
Umbra will feast on your soul.
Get out of here while you can.
All hail the Corrupter of Souls.
Blessings of the Lady upon you.
Have you been to Wellspring Grove?
I've been waiting for you, Associate.
The Palace is cut off, sire. We were the last to make it through from the Legion Compound.
translation_korean: 궁전이 고립됐습니다, 폐하. 남은 병력이 없습니다.

source_english: I've been looking for you. We have a situation in Bruma that I need you to deal with.
translation_korean: 당신을 본 적이 있소. 우린 브루마처럼 당신의 도움이 필요한 상황이오.

source_english: Have you helped Captain Burd and his men close the Oblivion Gate yet?
translation_korean: 벌써 버드(Burd)의 경비대를 도와서 오블리비언 게이트를 닫았나?

source_english: I think we'd better get that Gate closed.
Thanks for coming. We could use your help.
Please... help me, I can't remember anything.
translation_korean: 부탁이에요... 절 도와 주세요. 난 아무것도 기억할 수 없어요.

source_english: We must get out of this place!
My word! You startled me! Are you real?
translation_korean: 어이구 야! 깜짝 놀랐어요! 당신 진짠가요?

source_english: How did I get here? Do you know the way out?
translation_korean: 어떻게 내가 여기 있죠? 나가는 길을 아나요?

source_english: Welcome back to the true world.
There isn't any more to say. Please, lay down and sleep.
translation_korean: 더 이상 말할게 없군요. 부디 누워 잠드세요.

source_english: This is your last chance to get ready. Once you're asleep, there's no coming back until Henantier awakens.
translation_korean: 이것이 준비하실 마지막 기회입니다. 일단 잠들고 나시면, 헤낸티어가 깰 때까진 돌아올 수 없습니다.

source_english: Be patient, all will be explained.
translation_korean: 인내심을 가져요. 모두 잘 풀릴 겁니다.

source_english: I hope you've prepared yourself. The journey you're to undertake could be dangerous.
translation_korean: 준비 잘했기를 바래요. 당신에게 맡겨진 이 여행은 위험할 수 있습니다.

source_english: So, have you managed to persuade Herminia Cinna to part with the Ayleid Crown?
translation_korean: 그래, Ayleid 왕관을 건네달라고 Herminia Cinna를 어떻게든 설득해보셨습니까?

source_english: Even in its ruined state, it is magnificent, isn't it? In the days of its power, Nenalata must have been glorious indeed.
translation_korean: 심지어 폐허가 된 상태에서조차 장엄하기 그지 없군요, 그렇지 않나요? 힘이 있었던 시대에, Nenalata는 실로 영광스러웠음이 틀림없어요.

source_english: I've got a bad feeling about this...
This can't be happening. This is horrible.
I fear we're in over our heads.
translation_korean: 우리가 감당 못할 짓을 한 건 아닌지 두렵군요.

source_english: This isn't my idea of a good time.
translation_korean: 내 생각에 시기가 좋지 않은 것 같군요.

source_english: I'm ready as I'll ever be.
You traveled a great distance to find me.
translation_korean: 날 찾으러 상당히 먼 거리를 왔군요.

source_english: Our conversations are done. There's nothing else to say.
translation_korean: 우리 대화는 끝났다. 더는 말할 게 없어.

source_english: Well, what're you just standing there for?
translation_korean: 글쎄, 단지 거기 서 있으면 뭐가 되나?

source_english: I thought that I was perfectly clear.
I guess I was wrong about you.
He told you where it is?
You have work to do. Go on. Get out of here.
translation_korean: 자네는 해야 할 일이 있을터. 어서. 가보게.

source_english: Don't let the ogres get me!
I'm on my way to talk to Itius Hayn.
translation_korean: 난 Itius Hayn에게 말하러 가는 길이오.

source_english: I'm trying to find Itius Hayn.
I'd like to report a crime. Watch Captain Avidius stole all my money while I was shopping in Jensine's Merchandise.
translation_korean: 범죄를 보고하고 싶습니다. 경비병 대장 아비디우스가 내가 젠신의 상품점에서 장을 보는 동안 내 돈 전부를 강탈해갔습니다.

source_english: The Gray Fox is waiting for you.
There are torches in the barrel.
Welcome to the Temple of the Ancestor Moths.
translation_korean: 고대 모스의 사원에 오신 것을 환영합니다.

source_english: You may join us for morning prayers in the chapel.
translation_korean: 당신은 사원의 아침기도에 참여할 수 있습니다.

source_english: I hope you have found your stay here pleasant.
translation_korean: 여기에서 쾌적히 숙박할 곳을 찾았으면 좋겠네.

source_english: We might be able to grow turnips next spring.
translation_korean: 우리는 내년 봄에는 순무(turnip)를 기를 수 있을 겁니다.

source_english: The latest batch of silk is ready, brother Hridi.
translation_korean: 마지막 비단 뭉치가 준비되었습니다. Hridi 형제님.

source_english: Brother Hridi, your homily was most inspiring.
translation_korean: Hridi 형제님, 당신의 강론은 매우 감동적이었습니다.

source_english: The silk gardens are doing well, brother Hjar.
translation_korean: 비단 정원은 아주 잘 되었습니다, Hjar 형제님.

source_english: Brother Hjar, we must clean the chapel soon.
translation_korean: Hjar 형제님, 우리는 곧 교회를 청소해야 합니다.

source_english: The cemetary is well tended, brother Holger.
translation_korean: 묘지는 잘 관리되어 있군요, Holger 형제님.

source_english: Brother Holger, we need to prepare for the ritual of purity by the next full moon.
translation_korean: Holger 형제님, 우리는 다음 보름달이 뜨기 전에 순결의 의식을 준비해야 합니다.

source_english: The situation is not good. We have to act now.
translation_korean: 상황이 좋지 않아. 우리는 지금 행동해야 합니다.

source_english: A string of thefts should do the trick.
The plan should work, with the Shadow's blessing.
translation_korean: 그 계획은 그림자의 축복과 함께 이루어질 것입니다.

source_english: We need more pressure on Lex. He's a stubborn fetcher.
translation_korean: 우리는 렉스에게 더 많은 압박을 가할 필요가 있습니다. 그는 고집불통입니다.

source_english: I have word that two of the jobs were successful.
No sign of the Gray Fox, sir.
I'm looking for the Gray Fox. What can you tell me?
translation_korean: 난 그레이 폭스를 찾고 있습니다. 나한테 할말이 없습니까?

source_english: I have an arrest warrant for the Gray Fox. Do you know where he is?
translation_korean: 난 그레이 폭스에 대한 체포 영장을 발부했습니다. 당신은 그가 어디 있는지 아는가요?

source_english: The Gray Fox is hiding nearby. What do you know about him?
translation_korean: 그레이 폭스가 근처에 숨어있습니다. 그에 대해 아는가요?

source_english: A curse on that Hieronymus Lex!
I hope the Imperial Watch goes away soon.
translation_korean: 난 제국의 경비대가 빨리 떠나길 바랍니다.

source_english: How are we supposed to live under this curfew?
translation_korean: 어떻게 우리는 통행금지령 아래에서 살고 있는 거야?

source_english: We have to stay in our homes while the Watch searches for the Gray Fox.
translation_korean: 그레이 폭스에 대한 조사를 하는 동안 우리는 집안에 머물려야 합니다.

source_english: I'll never tell those damn Watchmen about the Gray Fox!
translation_korean: 난 그레이 폭스에 대해 그 망할 경비병에게는 말 안할 거야!

source_english: I've told the Watch that I don't know anything about the Gray Fox.
translation_korean: 나는 그레이 폭스에 대해서는 아무것도 모른다고 얘기했습니다.
이방인에 대해 뭐 아는 것 있나?
이방인에 대해 뭐 아는 것 있나?
당신은 여기서 환영 받지 않는다고, 이방인.

source_english: We don't like strangers meddling in our affairs.
translation_korean: 우리는 이방인들이 우리 일에 간섭하는 걸 좋아하지 않아.

source_english: I hope you bring good news.
I knew I could count on you.
translation_korean: 당신에게 기대할 수 있다는 걸 알았죠.

source_english: It's a pleasure to see you.

translation_korean: 당신이 좋은 소식을 가지고 왔기 바랍니다.

source_english: You look uneasy. I hope things are going well.
translation_korean: 불안해 보이는 군요. 난 모든 게 잘 될 거라 믿습니다.

source_english: Anything you require, you're welcome to it.
translation_korean: 당신이 원하는 게 무엇이든, 맘대로 하셔도 됩니다.

source_english: This ship doesn't move 'til I know that Ormil's safe.
translation_korean: 제가 오르밀이 안전하다는 걸 알기 전까지 이 배는 움직이지 않을 겁니다.

source_english: I'm staying right here... where it's safe.
translation_korean: 난 바로 여기에 머물고 있소... 그게 안전하거든.

source_english: What can I do for you this fine day?
I can't wait until I gaze upon the Tears with my own eyes.
translation_korean: 내 두 눈으로 그 눈물을 볼 때까지 기다릴 수 없을 것 같네.

source_english: Back again so soon I see.
Aren't you supposed to be on your way to the Imperial City?

translation_korean: 안녕하세요. 코롤 성에 오신 것을 환영합니다.

source_english: I sing your praises and welcome you again.
I was praying for your swift return.
translation_korean: 당신의 빠른 귀환을 위해 기도하고 있었어요.
아마도 당신이 날 도울 수 있을 것 같군요.

source_english: Ah yes, the Mythic Dawn scholar. What else can I help you with?
translation_korean: 아 네, 미식 던(Mythic Dawn)을 연구하는 학자가 맞소. 또 어떤 도움이 필요하시오?

source_english: I'm surprised to see you here. Have you been to talk to Baurus in the Imperial City yet?
translation_korean: 여기서 보게 되다니 놀랍군. 임페리얼시티에 있는 보러스는 아직 만나보지 않은 건가?

source_english: We will exact our revenge on the Mythic Dawn for the Emperor's murder. By the holy blood of Talos, Mankar Camoran will pay for his crimes!
translation_korean: 미식 던(Mythic Dawn)의 황제 시해에 대해서는 엄중한 복수를 할걸세. 신성한 탈로스의 피로 맨카 케모런(Mankar Camoran)의 죄값을 받아낼 것이야!

source_english: It sounds like you and Baurus are making progress in your hunt for the Amulet of Kings. Good work.
translation_korean: 자네와 보러스가 왕의 아뮬렛을 되찾는 일에 진전이 있다고 들었네. 잘하고 있네.

source_english: Once you locate the Mythic Dawn's shrine to Mehrunes Dagon, we may have a chance to recover the Amulet!
translation_korean: 일단 자네가 메르네스 데이건(Mehrunes Dagon)이 있는 미식 던(Mythic Dawn) 성지의 위치만 파악하면, 아뮬렛을 되찾을 기회가 있을 걸세!

source_english: So wonderful to see you again. I don't know what I would have done without your help.
translation_korean: 당신을 다시 만나다니 정말 멋진 날이군요. 당신의 도움이 없었다면 내가 뭘 해야 했을 지 모를 거에요.

source_english: Oh, I'll never get that crystal ball back. Not with those frightful spirits floating around...
translation_korean: 오, 전 그 수정구를 되찾지 못할 거에요. 주위를 떠다니는 그 소름 끼치는 유령들만 없다면...

source_english: Oh! You've returned! I do hope you have good news.
translation_korean: 오! 돌아왔군요! 당신이 좋은 소식을 가져 왔길 빌어요.

source_english: Have you anything new to report?
Yes, ma'am? What can I do for you?
Yes, sir? What can I do for you?
Join the Guild, and fight for gold.
translation_korean: 길드에 가입해라. 그리고 돈을 위해 싸워라.

source_english: Looking for action? Think about the Fighters Guild.
I'm gonna go get me some black bows. Tag along if you like.
translation_korean: 난 블랙보우 몇 개를 가지러 갈 거야. 네가 원한다면 쫓아와도 좋아.

source_english: I fear the enemy came here for the Amulet of Kings.
translation_korean: 놈들이 왕의 아뮬렛을 노리고 온 거라면 큰일이네...

source_english: We should get Martin to Cloud Ruler Temple immediately.
translation_korean: 마틴을 즉시 클라우드 룰러(Cloud Ruler) 사원으로 모셔야 해.

source_english: Is something wrong? Why are we stopping?
Out of the frying pan into the fire, eh?
This wasn't part of the plan, was it?
translation_korean: 이것도 계획의 일부는 아닌 것 같은데, 그렇지 않소?

source_english: It's about time you got here.
There is still a chance to strike back at the Necromancers.
translation_korean: 아직 네크로맨서들에게 한방 먹일 수 있어요.

source_english: The guild needs you more than ever.
What can I do for you now, my friend?
Ah, we meet again. No hard feelings, I hope!
translation_korean: 아, 다시 만났군. 바라건대, 나쁘게 생각하지 말게나!

source_english: Don't worry, I hold no grudges. You bested me! I am man enough to admit it!
translation_korean: 걱정 말게, 난 아무 유감도 없으니까. 자넨 날 이겼어! 난 그걸 인정할 만큼 충분한 남자라네!

source_english: And here you are again, my friend!
translation_korean: 그래서 다시 여기에 왔군, 내 친구여!

source_english: Umbacano nearly did us in this time, and no mistake.
translation_korean: 의심의 여지 없이, 움바카노는 우리를 모두 죽일 뻔 했다네.

source_english: You want to speak to me?
translation_korean: 당신이 나와 이야기를 하고 싶다고 했소?

source_english: Thought I sent you to Harlun's Watch.
You've got a contract. Shouldn't you be in Bruma?
translation_korean: 자넨 청부를 받았네. 왜 브루마(Bruma)에 있지 않은건가?

source_english: Don't you have a rat problem to be handling, boot?
Shouldn't have any more problems with those cats.
translation_korean: 더이상 저 고양이들로 인한 문제는 없겠죠.

source_english: Let's kill us some big cats.
What can I do for you?
I am at your mercy for now, scum.
Get away! You will die here!
What's the story on Maglir and his contract?
translation_korean: Maglir와 그의 의뢰에 대한 이야기가 뭐지?

source_english: Wait! I need to speak with you!
It is good to see you again.
I've been waiting for you. Have a seat.
You're back! Have a seat and tell me everything.
translation_korean: 돌아 왔구나! 앉아서 모든 것을 말해봐.

source_english: Thank you for convincing her to meet with me.
translation_korean: 날 만나도록 그녀를 설득해 주셔서 감사합니다.

source_english: Hmm. You don't look like a vampire...
This is a restricted area, I'm afraid. Guild mages only.
translation_korean: 미안하지만 이곳은 출입금지 구역이에요. 오직 길드 메이지만 들어올 수 있어요.

source_english: I hope the work at Vahtacen goes well.
There's more work to be done.
I don't have time to help you now!
Stick with the plan, and everything should go smoothly.
Welcome back to the world, convict! Hahaha.
translation_korean: 밖으로 돌아온 걸 환영해, 죄수! 하하하.

source_english: Did that fetcher give you any information?
I don't know what else to say.
You have no rights here, convict.
I had the diary, but one of them stole it from me.
translation_korean: 일기를 내가 가지고 있었는데, 그들 중 하나가 내게서 훔쳐갔어.

source_english: Hmmm. Maybe he lives in the Elven Gardens district.
translation_korean: 흐~음. 어쩌면 그자는 엘븐 가든 지역에 살고 있을지도.

source_english: I don't like the look of you. Keep moving.
translation_korean: 무슨 그따위 모습을 하고 있는거야. 저리 가.

source_english: I see there are too many thieves in the city.
translation_korean: 이 도시는 도둑이 너무 많은 것 같아. 지긋지긋해.

source_english: I've won the competition! My membership into the guild is assured.
translation_korean: 나의 승리다! 이것으로 나의 길드 입회가 확정됐어.

source_english: La la la, la la la la...
translation_korean: 라 라 라 라 라 라 라...

source_english: Oh dear, whatever could you want?
I... do not feel well. Please, excuse me.
translation_korean: 저... 는 지금 기분이 좋지 않군요. 실례하겠습니다.

source_english: Hey! Whoa! You shouldn't sneak up on people like that!
translation_korean: 헤이! 와우! 그런 식으로 사람들한테 몰래 접근할 게 아니었어!

source_english: Oh, Faelian, dear Faelian... why must you ruin both our lives?
translation_korean: 오! Faelain, 사랑하는 Faelian! 당신은 왜 우리 모두의 삶을 망치려고 하나요...

source_english: Brother, if I may have a word.
Sister, if I may have a word.
Excuse me, Brother. Can you spare a moment?
Excuse me, Sister. Can you spare a moment?
I've been meaning to speak with you.
I hope you have some good news this time.
translation_korean: 이번에는 좋은 소식을 가져 왔길 바라네

source_english: I am honored by your presence. How can Ocheeva be of assistance?
translation_korean: 나는 당신이 있어서 영광입니다. 어떻게 Ocheeva에게 도움이 될 수 있습니까?

source_english: You are finding your contracts agreeable, I hope?
translation_korean: 당신은 기분 좋은 계약을 찾아낸 건 아니지, 그렇지?

source_english: I do not know what Lucien sees in you, but this Sanctuary is cursed by your presence.
translation_korean: 루시엔이 당신에게서 무엇을 봤는지 모르지만, 당신이 존재함으로써 성역이 저주받았어.

source_english: Ah, here you are. So good to finally meet you.
translation_korean: 아, 여기 있습니다. 결국에 당신을 만나서 잘되었습니다.

source_english: You are like a dark gift from the Night Mother herself. Please, tell me how I can help.
translation_korean: 당신은 나이트 마더로부터의 어둠의 선물이군요. 제발, 내가 어떻게 도울 수 말해주시오.

source_english: Were I not ordered to assist you I would forgo the Tenets and feast on your blood!
translation_korean: 나는 당신이 나에게 율법을 무시하고 피의 잔치를 하도록 돕기로 한 게 아니야!

source_english: I've heard so much about you. Welcome to our family!
translation_korean: 난 당신에 대해 많이 들었습니다. 우리가족에게 오신 것을 환영합니다!

source_english: So good to see you! Is there anything you need?
translation_korean: 만나서 좋습니다! 뭐 필요한 게 있나요?

source_english: Seeing you in this Sanctuary makes me wish I were back on the streets.
translation_korean: 이 성역에서 당신을 보고 있으니 마치 내가 그 거리로 돌아온 것처럼 소망하게 만드는 군요.

source_english: I wish to welcome you to this Sanctuary, my newest Brother.
translation_korean: 나는 이 성역에 오신 당신을 환영합니다, 내 새 형제여.

source_english: I wish to welcome you to this Sanctuary, my newest Sister.
translation_korean: 나는 이 성역에 오신 당신을 환영합니다, 내 새 자매여.

source_english: It fills my heart with warmth to see you again, Brother.
translation_korean: 당신을 다시 만나게 되어 가슴이 따뜻해져 옵니다. 형제여.

source_english: It fills my heart with warmth to see you again, Sister.
translation_korean: 당신을 다시 만나게 되어 가슴이 따뜻해져 옵니다. 자매여.

source_english: My scales grow cold whenever you approach.
translation_korean: 당신이 다가올 때마다 내 비늘이 써늘해져.

source_english: It is an honor to make your acquaintance.
Seeing you again is like a blessing from the Night Mother herself!
translation_korean: 당신을 다시 볼 수 있다니 나이트 마더의 축복 같군요!

source_english: You. I hoped Sithis would have claimed you by now.
translation_korean: 너. 나는 Sithis가 당장 당신의 목숨을 빼앗기를 바랬습니다.

source_english: If not for the Tenets, I would slay you where you stand!
translation_korean: 아니 율법만 아니라면, 난 당신을 그 자리에서 죽일 거야!

source_english: Ah, there you are! It's good to see you again! No, really, I mean it!
But why, Sister? Why must I use stealth? Sneaking around in the shadows is so very... slow.
translation_korean: 그런데 왜, 자매님? 내가 왜 은닉을 사용해야 합니까? 어둠 속에서 은닉하는 것은 아주 아주.느립니다.

source_english: I speak for the Night Mother.
May we forever serve the Night Mother.
You are like an unholy vision. So beautiful.
Betrayer! I have found you at last! Your reckoning is at hand!
translation_korean: 배신자! 내가 마침내 당신을 찾았소! 귀하에 대한 심판이 닥쳤어!

source_english: Silencer! What news do you bring?
You honor us with your presence.
Ah, you have arrived. Come now, we must speak. The Black Hand has need of your... talents.
translation_korean: 아, 당신이 도착했습니다. 자, 우리 얘기해봅시다. The Black Hand는 당신의 도움... 재능이 필요합니다.

source_english: You need something? A room maybe?
By Ysmer's beard, not you again!
Well, well. Who might you be?
I can't help but smile when I see you, friend.
translation_korean: 돕진 못해도 마주치면 웃어는 주겠소, 친구.

source_english: I didn't think Manheim allowed dogs in here.
translation_korean: 나는 Manheim이 여기에 개를 허용했다고 생각하지 않았어요.

source_english: You ain't one of me crew. What business ye be havin' here, mate?
translation_korean: 당신은 나의 부하가 아니야. 어떤 일로 당신은 여기 있는 거지, 친구?

source_english: You do NOT belong in here!
There once was hardy young lad of the sea... A Redguard of courage and honor was he... Sail on, my Cyrus, sail on...
translation_korean: 언젠가 이 바다의 튼튼한 젊은이가 있었지... Redguard 용기와 명예를 가진 그가... 항해하자, 내 사이러스, 항해하자...

source_english: Hides-His-Heart will be here any moment!
Oh! Oh look! My goodness... Two people here to confront me! Whatever shall I do?
translation_korean: 오! 오, 봐! 세상에... 두 사람을 여기에서 대면하게 되는가! 내가 무엇을 해야 하는가?

source_english: I... I must get to the Grey Mare. Must get away from here...
translation_korean: 난... 나는 회색의 암말(Grey Mare)에 가야 합니다. 여기서 멀리 떨어져...

source_english: Ah, the Gray Mare! Chorrol's finest repository of wine, women and song!
translation_korean: 아, 회색의 암말(Gray Mare)! Chorrol 최고의 와인과 여자 그리고 노래가 있는 곳!

source_english: I have a job to do, and nothing will stand in my way!
translation_korean: 난 할 일이 있고, 아무것도 나의 길을 막을 수 없어!

source_english: You've got to get me out of here! Come on, open the door!
translation_korean: 날 여기서 나가게 해주시겠어요! 어서, 문을 열어주시오!

source_english: I can't quite decide where I should look. I don't want to break anything but the chest of gold could be hidden anywhere.
translation_korean: 나는 어디를 보아야 할지 잘 결정할 수가 없군요. 난 어딘가 숨겨져있을 황금의 상자를 제외하고는 아무것도 부수길 원하지 않습니다.

source_english: Two of us have been murdered! One of us is a killer! But who?
translation_korean: 우리들 중 두 사람이 살해당했습니다! 우리 중 하나가 범인입니다! 하지만 누가?

source_english: It's not safe to be alone. I certainly don't want to be the third victim.
translation_korean: 혼자 있는 것은 안전하지 않습니다. 난 분명히 말해 세번째 희생자가 되고 싶지 않습니다.

source_english: This house is a deathtrap! We're being killed off, one by one!
translation_korean: 이 집은 죽음의 함정입니다! 우리는 하나씩 살해당할 것입니다!

source_english: So many people dead. I just don't know who to trust anymore.
translation_korean: 그래서 많은 사람들이 죽었습니다. 나는 단지 누구를 더 신뢰해야 할지 모르겠습니다.

source_english: It's... it's you... you're the only one left. You did it! You killed them all!
translation_korean: 그건... 당신... 당신만 남았어요. 당신이 했군요! 당신이 그들 모두를 죽였어!

source_english: So that's it. It's down to you and me. I know I'm no killer, so that means...
translation_korean: 그게 그거야. 그것은 당신과 나의 책임입니다. 난 살인자가 아니에요, 그래서 그 뜻은...

source_english: You and I are the only ones left, but we're not alone in this house. That killer is in here with us, hiding. But where?
translation_korean: 당신과 나만 남아 있지만, 우리는 이 집에서 혼자가 아니에요. 그 범인은 여기에 숨어있습니다. 하지만 어디에?

source_english: You and I are the only ones left. But we did it. We survived. We... we won!
translation_korean: 당신과 나만 남아 있지만, 그러나 우리는 그것을 이루었습니다. 우리는...우리는 승리하였습니다.

source_english: Aha! There you are. Took you long enough to get here.
translation_korean: 아하! 여기 있습니다. 이것을 얻기에 너무 오래 걸렸습니다.

source_english: Time for you to cash in on my success.
translation_korean: 내 성공으로 당신이 이득을 볼 시간이 왔어요.

source_english: No time to talk. I've got a job to do.
translation_korean: 대화할 시간 없어요. 전 할일이 있다구요.

source_english: Help, help! You've got to do something!
I hope this is important, Associate.
Martin Septim, on behalf of the Elder Council, I accept your claim to the Imperial Throne. We should arrange the coronation ceremony as soon as ...
translation_korean: 원로위원회의 이름으로, 마틴 셉팀을 제국의 황제로서 그 권리를 인정합니다. 준비되는 대로, 될 수 있는 한 빠른 시일 내에 대관식을 거행...

source_english: Chancellor Ocato! The city is under attack! Oblivion Gates have opened, and daedra are inside the walls! The guard is overwhelmed!
translation_korean: 오카토(Ocato) 위원장님! 시가 공격 당하고 있습니다! 오블리비언 게이트가 열리고 데이드라들이 성 안으로 침입했습니다! 경비대로는 역부족입니다!

source_english: Your Highness, what are your orders? Shall the Guard fall back to the Palace?
translation_korean: 전하, 명령을 내려주십시오. 경비대를 궁전으로 철수시킬까요?

source_english: Sire, Chancellor Ocato is expecting you. He had word of your arrival in the capital.
translation_korean: 폐하, 오카토(Ocato) 위원장께서 기다리고 계십니다. 폐하께서 중앙 회의실로 도착하실 것으로 알고 있습니다.

source_english: Everything is ready for Martin's arrival, don't worry.
You made it! Not that I was worried about you.
translation_korean: 역시 해냈군요! 해 낼 줄 알았어요.

source_english: Do you think we have a chance, sir?
Do you think we have a chance, ma'am?
The daedra seemed to come out of nowhere!
I heard that Oblivion Gates are opening all over the city!
We just made it through to the Palace. The Market District was swarming with daedra.
translation_korean: 길을 확보해야 해. 상가 지역은 이미 데이드라들로 덮였어.

source_english: Have pity sir. I gots nothin' ta eat.
Have pity beautiful lady, I gots nothin' ta eat.
translation_korean: 아름다운 숙녀님, 한푼 만 줍쇼. 종일 굶었다오.

source_english: A coin for an old beggar?
Me children are starving. Please help.
Have pity on an old war veteran.
Spare a coin for the infirm?
I'm only asking for a single coin.
Who will help an old beggar?
Flyyyin'... flyyin' in the skyyyy.... cliff racer flys so high.... flyinnn'...
translation_korean: 나아아네... 하느으으으을... 나아아아네.... 절벽 질주자가 아주 높이 나아안다네...

source_english: I've come from speaking with Count Indarys, and I've news for you.
translation_korean: 인다리스 백작님과 얘기하다 왔는데... 새로운 소식이 있습니다.

source_english: I must speak to the Count.
I trust there were no run-ins with the guards in the barracks.
translation_korean: 막사에 있는 경비병들과 싸움이 없었다는 걸 믿습니다.

source_english: I must speak to the Count.
I feel Ulrich's eyes upon me as we speak, so be brief.
translation_korean: 우리가 얘기할 때, 울리히가 감시한다는 느낌이 들어요. 그러니 짧게 말해요.

source_english: I'm very disappointed at the decision you've made.
I did what needed to be done.
That's all I'll be needing you for. Stay and watch, but don't interfere.
translation_korean: 당신이 필요한 것 뿐이에요. 간섭하지 말고 보고만 있어요.

source_english: Please, go get Ulrich and convince him to follow you here. I'll do the rest.
translation_korean: 어서, 울리히 그 놈을 찾아서 당신을 따라 오도록 설득하십시오. 나머진 제가 하겠습니다.

source_english: Is something amiss? You have an ashen look on your face that tells me so.
translation_korean: 뭐가 잘못됐나요? 당신 얼굴이 창백한 걸 보니 무슨 소식이 있나 봅니다.

source_english: I'm glad to see you've returned.
They say there's a gate opened outside the city! Let's go!
translation_korean: 시 외곽에 차원문이 열렸다고 한다! 가보자!

source_english: You look like you can hold your own in a fight.
translation_korean: 당신은 싸움에서 자기 스스로를 지킬 수 있을 것 같군요.

source_english: You look upset that we deceived you. Please, don't be.
translation_korean: 우리가 당신을 속여서 당황한 것 같군요. 부디 진정하세요.

source_english: I heard you made contact with the gang. Beauties, aren't they?
translation_korean: 당신이 그 범죄단과 접촉했다고 들었습니다. 미인들이죠, 그렇지 않나요?

source_english: Have any success at The Flowing Bowl?
I've already told you pretty much everything I know about their gang.
translation_korean: 난 이미 당신에게 그 범죄단에 대해 알고 있는 모든 것을 말해 드렸습니다.

source_english: I sure don't like the looks of that Gate.
translation_korean: 물론 나는 그 게이트가 보기 싫소.

source_english: Do you really think we can close that thing?
translation_korean: 정말 그걸 닫을 수 있다고 보시오?

source_english: We've got to get out of here!
I sure hope you know what you're doing.
I don't like the looks of this.

translation_korean: 내가 할 수 있는 건 뭐든지...

source_english: You're back. What news do you bring me?
You're back. What news do you bring me?
I can't speak to you right now.
translation_korean: 지금 당장 당신과 얘기할 수 없습니다.

source_english: I don't know what else to tell you.
translation_korean: 당신에게 말할 게 뭐가 있는지 모르겠군요.

source_english: Good to see you, sir. We won't forget how you helped Anvil.
translation_korean: 반갑군요. Anvil에 대한 도움을 잊지 않을 거에요.

source_english: Good to see you, ma'am. We won't forget how you helped Anvil.
translation_korean: 반갑군요. Anvil에 대한 도움을 잊지 않을 거에요.

source_english: You're the one that saved Cheydinhal from that Oblivion Gate, aren't you?
translation_korean: 오블리비언 게이트로부터 Cheydinhal을 구한 사람이군요, 그렇죠?

source_english: You don't need to worry about the daedra taking Bruma. You've got the best soldiers in Cyrodiil here now.
translation_korean: 브루마(Bruma)를 데이드라에게 빼앗길 염려는 할 필요 없소. 시로딜 최고의 병사들이 여기 모였소.

source_english: I'm looking forward to some payback for what those bastards did to Kvatch.
translation_korean: 크바치에서 놈들에게 진 빚을 돌려주고야 말겠소.

source_english: How long will Bruma need our help? Count Caro's orders were to return to Leyawiin as soon as Bruma was secure.
translation_korean: 브루마(Bruma)에 얼마나 있어야 겠소? 카로(Caro) 백작께선 브루마의 안전이 확보되는 데로 곧장 레이어윈(Leyawiin)으로 돌아오라고 명하셨소.

source_english: I can't wait to get back to Skingrad. I ain't cut out for this damned weather.
translation_korean: 스킨그라드(Skingrad)로 돌아가야 겠소. 빌어먹을 날씨를 견딜 수 없소.

source_english: Do you think the attack will come soon, ma'am?
Do you think the attack will come soon, sir?
Do you think we stand a chance?
Let's teach those bastards a lesson!
There's no way I'm going in there!
Welcome aboard, sir. It will be an honor to serve with you.
translation_korean: 입단을 환영해. 같이 일하게 되어 영광이군.

source_english: Welcome aboard, ma'am. It will be an honor to serve with you.
translation_korean: 입단을 환영해. 같이 일하게 되어 영광이군.

source_english: You did it, Captain! You closed the Oblivion Gate! We didn't think we'd ever see you alive again!
translation_korean: 해냈어요, 대장! 대장이 오블리비언 게이트를 닫았어요! 다시는 살아서 못 보는 줄 알았어요!

source_english: The Eternal Garden... I used to dream about coming here. The Master made it sound so wonderful.
translation_korean: 야생의 정원... 여기 오는 게 꿈이었어. 마스터께서 정말 멋지게 만드셨어.

source_english: I wonder how long we've been here? There's no way to keep track of time.
translation_korean: 얼마나 더 여기 있어야 하지? 시간을 잴 수도 없어.

source_english: If I could kill myself, I would.
Mankar Camoran has a lot to answer for. No wonder he never comes down to the Eternal Garden.
translation_korean: 맨카 케모런(Mankar Camoran)은 많은 걸 해명해야 해. 그는 절대 야생의 정원으로 내려오지 않을거야.

source_english: The Master will call us back to Tamriel soon. I'm sure of it.
translation_korean: 마스터께서 곧 우릴 탐리엘(Tamriel)로 불러주실 거야. 난 확신해.

source_english: I never tire of the beauty of Gaiar Alata.
translation_korean: 가이아 알라타(Gaiar Alata)의 아름다움은 절대 질리지 않아.

source_english: I feel sure the Master will recognize my efforts and summon me to the Forbidden Grotto soon.
translation_korean: 마스터께서 곧 나의 노고를 알아주시고 금단의 동굴로 불러주실 것 같은 확신이 들어.

source_english: Do you think we're safe for a few minutes?
translation_korean: 우리가 몇 분 동안이나 안전할 것 같아?

source_english: I don't see any of them around right now.
translation_korean: 이젠 주변에 더 이상 그들이 보이질 않아.

source_english: I don't feel like talking right now.
Hey! I've been looking for you.
No sign of Armand Christophe, Sir.
Can you tell me where Armand Christophe is hiding?
translation_korean: 아르망 크리스토프가 어디 숨었는지 알려줄 수 있나?

source_english: You have kept your word. Now I will keep mine. What is it you wish to know?
translation_korean: 당신은 약속을 지키셨습니다. 이제 나도 지킬 것입니다. 당신이 알고 싶은 것이 뭐에요?

source_english: You will be sweet, bloody nectar for the lady.
translation_korean: 당신은 여성에게 달콤하고도, 피비린내 나는 꿀입니다.

source_english: Hey! You said you would unlock the door!
translation_korean: 헤이! 당신이 문을 딸 수 있을 거라고 했잖아!

source_english: Out of the way slop drudge.
Shouldn't you be feeding the prisoners, slop drudge?
translation_korean: 죄수들에게 먹이를 주어야 하지 않나, slop drudge?

source_english: Don't keep the Gray Fox waiting.
translation_korean: 그레이 폭스 님을 기다리시게 하지 말도록.

source_english: The blessing of the Fox upon you.
Ah, the Thieves Guild's new favorite.
There is nothing more important now than locating Martin and bringing him safely back here.
translation_korean: 이제 가장 시급한 일은 마틴(Martin)을 찾아 안전하게 데려오는 일일세.

source_english: You're back. Did you bring help?
Audens Avidius, you are under arrest for extortion and petty theft. Surrender peacefully and keep what little dignity you have left.
translation_korean: Audens Avidius, 넌 금품 강요와 사소한 절도죄로 체포된다. 조용히 항복해서 조금이라도 품위를 지켜라.

source_english: Did you hear what happened to Ruslan and Luronk? One of the Watchmen fleeced them for all their coin!
translation_korean: Ruslan과 Luronk에게 무슨 일이 생겼는지 들었어요? 경비대원 중의 하나가 그들의 돈을 빼앗아 갔데요!

source_english: Ruslan and Luronk are going around saying that some of the Imperial Watch are corrupt.
translation_korean: Ruslan과Luronk는 Imperial 경비대의 일부가 타락했다고 말하고 다니는 중이죠.

source_english: The Imperial Watch is asking around for anyone that might have seen Audens Avidius. He's escaped from prison!
translation_korean: Imperial 경비대가 Audens Avidius를 본 사람이 있는지 묻고 다니고 있습니다. 그자가 탈옥했다는 거에요!

source_english: My head is still spinning from everything that has happened. I'll need some time to adjust.
translation_korean: 최근의 일들이 머리 속에서 여전히 복잡하게 얽혀있어. 정리할 시간이 필요해.

source_english: That's three more that won't be reporting back to their Master.
translation_korean: 놈들이 더 이상 마스터에게 보고하는 일은 없겠군.

source_english: I haven't turned up anything new on my end yet.
translation_korean: 그 후로 새로운 사실은 아직 밝혀내지 못했네.
우리의 소박한 마을에 방문해 준 걸 환영합니다.

source_english: Why aren't you in Water's Edge?
translation_korean: 자네 왜 Water's Edge에 가 있지 않은 건가?

source_english: Didn't I send you to see Lord Rugdumph?
translation_korean: 나는 러그덤프 영주를 보기위해  너를 보내지않았냐?

source_english: The Knights of the Thorn triumph once again!
translation_korean: 가시의 기사단(Knights of the Thorn)이 다시 일어섰도다!

source_english: I long to spill more foul daedra blood this day... for Cheydinhal!
translation_korean: 셰이딘홀을 위해 오늘 사악한 데이드라의 피를 보리라!

source_english: This place is cursed... we must not let its spoiled ichor spill into our fair lands.
translation_korean: 이곳은 저주 받았어... 이 기운이 우리의 고귀한 땅에 흘러들 게 내버려 둬선 안돼.

source_english: I'm honored by your presence, friend.
Whatever comes out of that portal... Cheydinhal is ready.
translation_korean: 저 포탈에서 뭐가 나오든, Cheydinhal은 준비가 되어 있소.

source_english: Hail! This area is extremely dangerous. I'd recommend leaving quickly.
translation_korean: 이봐! 여긴 매우 위험해. 어서 떠나는 게 좋을 거야.

source_english: You handled yourself pretty well back there. Just keep out of our way, got it?
translation_korean: 자신이나 잘 돌봐. 걸리적거리지 말고, 알았어?

source_english: If you want to help, prisoner, keep alert and let us do our job.
translation_korean: 죄수, 돕고 싶으면 방해나 안되도록 조심해.

source_english: I've still got my eye on you, prisoner.
I follow the Emperor's orders, but that doesn't mean I trust you.
translation_korean: 황제의 지시에 따르겠지만 널 믿진 않아.

source_english: Are you all right, sire? We're clear, for now.
Glad to see you are well.
Stick close and you'll be alright.
The Blades have gotten the Emperor out of worse situations than this.
translation_korean: 블레이드는 지금보다 더 나쁜 상황에서도 황제를 호위한 적이 있어.

source_english: I don't like it. It's too quiet.
Keep quiet, and stay out of the way.
Don't try anything. I'm watching you.
Do as you're told, and you'll be all right.
translation_korean: 시키는 대로만 하면, 아무 일 없을 거야.

source_english: I believe you and I were fated to meet today.
Don't provoke them. They don't trust you.
translation_korean: 그들을 자극하지 말게. 그들은 자넬 믿지 않아.

source_english: I don't know where they're going.
I told you to stay with the Emperor!
You seem in good spirits... do you have good news?
translation_korean: 기분이 좋아 보이는군요... 좋은 소식이라도 있나요?

source_english: Any new information come to light?
Welcome to Jensine's "Good As New" Merchandise!
translation_korean: 어서 오세요, 젠신(Jensine)의 "Good As New" 상점입니다!

source_english: We should be on our way.
The Gray Fox is waiting inside.
Welcome to this holy library, Lady Camoran
translation_korean: 이 거룩한 도서관에 오신 것을 환영합니다, 레이디 Camoran님

source_english: The prophecies are vague on this point. Cross check it.
translation_korean: 예언은 이 지점에서 모호합니다. 그것을 재차 검토해 봅시다.

source_english: Transfer that scroll to the archives.
Remember to keep the blindfold on. Your eyes must only be used to read the scrolls.
translation_korean: 눈가리개를 유지하도록 하십시오. 눈은 스크롤을 읽을 때에만 사용해야 합니다.

source_english: You must get us out of here.
translation_korean: 자넨 우리를 여기서 빠져나가게 해야 해.

source_english: Look at the muscles on you!
You have the hands of a healer.
There's an air of Mysticism about you.
You have the eyes of a trained marksman.
You look like a bright one.
You have the hands of an illusionist.
Seems you've bloodied your knuckles a few times.
translation_korean: 당신의 주먹은 몇 차례 피투성이가 된 것처럼 보이군요.

source_english: There's a charge in the air. Been casting some destruction spells?
translation_korean: 공중에 마나가 있군요. 파괴마법을 좀 써왔나봐요?

source_english: You smell of death. Been conjuring up dead things?
translation_korean: 죽음의 냄새가 나는군요. 살아있지 않은 것들을 소환하셨나요?

source_english: You look like you've swung a mace or two in your time.
translation_korean: 평생 철퇴를 한두 번쯤 휘두른 것 같은 얼굴이군.

source_english: Looks like you're handy with a blade.
translation_korean: 보아하니 당신은 검을 다루는데 익숙한 것 같군요.

source_english: You're a fit one. Been running a lot?
You've got a real bounce to your step. I'll bet you're quite the acrobat.
translation_korean: 정말 탄력적인 걸음걸이를 가졌군요. 당신은 상당한 곡예술사라고 확신합니다.

source_english: How about mixing up some potions? You look like quite the alchemist.
translation_korean: 몇 가지 포션을 혼합하는 방법을 알고 있나요? 당신은 제법 연금술사 같아 보이네요.

source_english: You look skilled in Alteration. Maybe you can teach me something.
translation_korean: 당신은 숙련된 변이마법사 같군요. 아마 당신은 내게 뭔가를 가르쳐 주실 수 있을 겁니다.

source_english: You've got the hands of a smith. Must have spent some time repairing your gear.
translation_korean: 당신은 장인의 손을 하고 있군요. 장비 수리에 상당한 시간을 투자한게 분명하군요.

source_english: You look like someone who's comfortable in heavy armor.
I heard you know how to move in light armor.
translation_korean: 난 당신이 경무장을 어떻게 다루지는 안다고 들었어요.

source_english: You look like a shrewd businessman.
You've got some nimble fingers. What have you been getting into?
translation_korean: 당신은 아주 교묘한 손놀림을 가지고 있네요. 들어가본데는 어딥니까?

source_english: You've got quite the silver tongue.
You're making me nervous, sneaking around like that. Just make sure you keep your hands to yourself.
translation_korean: 주변에서 얼쩡되니 무지 신경쓰이는데. 함부로 손 놀리지 마라.

source_english: Greetings, child of the Ra Gada.
Why do you bother me? Go away!
I see you've returned safely, Associate.
Stay back! We mustn't be seen!
translation_korean: 가만히 있어요! 우리가 눈에 띄어서는 안되요!

source_english: Oh, you're still alive! I was worried!
translation_korean: 오, 아직 살아 있었군요! 정말 걱정했어요!

source_english: What can I do for you?
We have awaited your arrival, messenger.
translation_korean: 전령이여, 우리는 아주 오랫동안 자네가 도착하기를 기다려 왔다네.

source_english: Don't you have somewhere else to be?
Let me go paint us a way out of here.
We must get out of this place.
You've returned! But where is Rythe?
Please hurry, I fear Rythe is in danger.
translation_korean: 제발 서둘러주세요, 라이스가 위험에 빠진 것 같아 두려워요.

source_english: Please, I don't know where to turn.
translation_korean: 부탁입니다, 어떻게 해야 할 지 모르겠어요.

source_english: Please hurry, I fear Rythe is in danger.
translation_korean: 제발 서둘러주세요, 라이스가 위험에 빠진 것 같아 두려워요.

source_english: You look like someone I might be able to help.
translation_korean: 자넨 내 도움이 필요한 사람 같은데.

source_english: I'm not sure I can trust you. Why don't you just move along.
translation_korean: 당신을 믿어도 되는지 잘 모르겠어요. 그냥 가시는 게 어때요.

source_english: I abhor killing, but you did the right thing.
translation_korean: 난 살인을 혐오합니다만, 당신은 옳은 일을 했어요.

source_english: Selene'll get what's coming to her when we arrive home.
translation_korean: Selene은 우리가 집에 도착하면 어떻게든 처리될 겁니다.

source_english: What can I do for you?
You aren't a member of the castle staff. What are you doing here?
translation_korean: 당신은 성에서 일하는 직원이 아닌데요. 여기서 뭐 하시는 겁니까?

source_english: You look familiar. Do I know you?
translation_korean: 당신 낯이 익군. 내가 아는 분입니까?

source_english: You are in good spirits today, milady
Oh my! Are you an adventurer?
My fate is in your hands.
Welcome to the Great Hall of Castle Chorrol, milord.
translation_korean: 코롤 성의 대회랑에 오신 걸 환영합니다, 신사분.

source_english: Welcome to the Great Hall of Castle Chorrol, milady.
translation_korean: 코롤 성의 대회랑에 오신 걸 환영합니다, 숙녀분.

source_english: This is a stopgap hello because none of the other Hellos have blank LinkFrom lists. Mark will fix this soon, I bet.
translation_korean: 이것은 개발하는 동안 임시로 추가된 HELLO 글입니다. 다른 LinkFrom 목록이 없는 HELLO 항목이 없었기 때문에. 이 부분은 Mark를 해결 해주는 것입니다.

source_english: ABOVE HERE ARE GREETINGS THAT CAN LINK TO OTHER GREETINGS
translation_korean: 이 문장은 게임내의 테스트를 위한 것으로 번역을 생략합니다.

source_english: What do you want, Breton trash?
Speak, snowman, and stop wasting my time.
You have something to say, dungheap?
Come to bother me with a war story, Redguard?
translation_korean: 전쟁 이야기로 나를 괴롭히러 왔나, 레드가드?
